programs.title: 30 days of darkness
programs.desc: The town of Barrow, Alaska, goes dark for thirty days every year.Most residents leave their homes at this time.The safety of those who decided to stay is ensured by young sheriff Eben Olsen (Josh Hartnett).He is struggling with serious personal problems.His marriage with Stella (Melissa George) is in crisis and she wants to leave him.Soon, however, they must unite their forces and fight the vampires who attack a town cut off from the world and plunged in darkness.Hungry monsters launch a bloody hunt for people imprisoned in Barrow.Eben, Stella and a handful of survivors begin their fight for survival.They do everything to wait for the end of the polar night.Adapted from a comic book by Steve Niles and Ben Templesmith.

programs.title: Peter Rabbit
programs.desc: Mischievous Peter and his large family live in a hole next to the garden of the elderly McGregor.Relations between them have long been strained.Unwanted guests regularly steal vegetables and fruits.Their ally is the sensitive artist Bea (Rose Byrne).When an unfriendly senior dies of a heart attack, the rabbits enjoy freedom, but this state does not last long.His relative, Tomasz (Domhnall Gleeson), comes to the estate inherited from the pensioner.Once there, he finds chaos left by the previous owner and a group of intruders who will not give up their habits so easily.The man wants to get rid of pests.However, this will not be an easy task.

programs.title: The Pig Who Cried Werewolf
programs.desc: A bad wolf lives next to three little pigs, Heimlich, Dieter and Chef.The first of them discovers that under the influence of the moon he transforms into a woman who is obsessed with catching pigs.

programs.title: Trolls
programs.desc: Trolls are cheerful, singing and fabulously colorful creatures that live in a colorful forest.None of them have any idea what the world around them is like.Poppy displays their positive attitude the most.Her carefreeness and joy is shared by everyone, except Mruk.The troll believes that his brethren are in danger.These words come true when the village of nice creatures is found by their greatest enemies, the Bergens.All of Poppy's friends are kidnapped and she must set out to rescue them.She is accompanied by Mruk, who is reluctant to leave his home.In the Polish language version, the characters were voiced by, among others: Magdalena Wasylik, Piotr Bajtlik, Ewa Konstancja Bułhak and Bartosz Obuchowicz.

programs.title: Trolls World Tour
programs.desc: Poppy lives a peaceful life in her colorful and singing kingdom.One day he learns that beyond his borders there are other lands inhabited by trolls.Each of them has different rhythms.Just as she loves pop, the creatures inhabiting distant lands prefer rock, funk, techno, country and classical music.The curious queen, together with Mruk and other friends, sets off on a journey to meet and unite her kin.She will have to face the rebellious Barb, who wants to ensure that only rock rules in all lands.The continuation of the 2016 hit sticks to a proven recipe for success - a joyful, extremely colorful animation packed with great hits, showing the unifying power of music and the need for tolerance.The pandemic made the film go down in cinema history as the first high-budget production that went straight to VOD services, without a cinema premiere.In the Polish language version, the characters were voiced by, among others:Magdalena Wasylik (Poppy), Piotr Bajtlik (Mruk) and Monika Węgiel-Jarocińska (Barb).

programs.title: Destiny
programs.desc: The development of science and the emergence of time travel provide a chance to avoid the largest bomb attack in history.The explosion had occurred in New York ten years earlier.The risky task is undertaken by a secret government agency headed by Robertson.He realizes the danger.Since any interference with past events can irreversibly change the present, he develops a plan to eliminate the terrorist without side effects.He chooses a random agent to carry out the mission.He is to recruit a younger version of the criminal into his organization.At the same time, he makes surprising discoveries about himself.

programs.title: Passengers
programs.desc: A group of people set off on a spaceship to a planet intended for colonization in a distant galaxy.Since the journey is expected to last 120 years, the expedition participants are put into hibernation.Unfortunately, the system turns out to be unreliable and mechanic Jim wakes up early.Because he feels lonely, he decides to find a companion.His choice falls on the charming writer Aurora.He wakes her up from sleep.They fall in love, but the idyll does not last long.They discover that the spaceship they are traveling on is in great danger, and the lives of other passengers depend only on them.They also gradually realize why their waking up was not accidental.Soon the couple's love is put to a difficult test.

programs.title: La grazia
programs.desc: The President of Italy (Toni Servillo) is at the end of his term.In six months, his political and social role will come to an end.At this time, the head of state faces moral dilemmas caused by the euthanasia regulations and the issue of pardoning two life sentences.Every decision will expose the politician to criticism, but it is up to him to decide which crime deserves forgiveness: an act of mercy or murder.Bending under the weight of responsibility, the statesman tries to buy time.At the same time, he struggles with personal problems.Despite the passage of 40 years, he still has not forgiven his deceased wife's betrayal, and he cannot find the way to his daughter (Anna Ferzetti).Ultimately, however, it proves that even if you know yourself perfectly, you can make a decision that will surprise everyone and bring inner freedom.

programs.title: Completement cramé
programs.desc: A widowed, wealthy Englishman, Andrew Blake (John Malkovich), goes to France, the homeland of his beloved wife.When he arrives at the stately mansion with a suitcase, to his surprise he is not mistaken for a guest, but a candidate for a butler.To stay as long as possible in the place where he met the love of his life years ago, he accepts a job offer and does not reveal the real destination of his trip to anyone.He meets the owner of the historic mansion, the widow Nathalie Beauvillier (Fanny Ardant), the housekeeper and cook Odile (Émilie Dequenne), the maid Manon (Eugénie Anselin) and the estate manager Philippe.Over time, he becomes friends with the residents and helps them look at their lives from a different perspective.Thanks to this, he also finds his lost joy and motivation to act.

programs.title: Dodgeball: A True Underdog Story
programs.desc: Peter La Fleur owns a small gym.The club has a few friendly clients - among them the shy Gordon, Steve and Owen, who is constantly looking for true love - but it does not make any profits.One day, the man is visited by lawyer Kate Veatch, representing the bank.He declares that the indebted premises will be taken over by White Goodman's network of thriving clubs.The only salvation for the Le Fleur club seems to be the upcoming dodgeball competition, in which the main prize is $50,000.From the helpless members of his club, Peter forms a team whose enthusiasm far exceeds their skills.Goodman does not give up and puts his players on the field.

programs.title: Our Son
programs.desc: Nicky (Luke Evans) shares his life with Gabriel (Billy Porter), who has devoted himself to raising their son.The other father has been feeling disappointed for some time and finally files for divorce.
